author: NahuBDF
quote:
The only redeeming quality about this game are the graphics. It was released in such an awful state, with constant frame drops and a huge amount of bugs and glitches. On top of that, it's not really a GTA game. It feels like a Red Dead Redemption 2 in modern times. They went too far into the realistic and MUNDANE side of things and the gameplay ended up being extremely boring and inane. The story we're supposed to get invested in is boring and the characters are unlikeable and don't behave like real people. They went so hard on the realism in gameplay and they forgot to write believable characters. Overall, it's one of the biggest disappointments ever.

I gave it the lowest scores because I cannot believe we all waited 13 years for such a broken mess **** that doesn't even play like a GTA.

author: NahuBDF
quote: Absolutely unplayable on even high end hardware. It's disgusting developers keep releasing games before they're finished and optimized and this practice needs to stop. I'm refunding the game because I won't pay for the PROMISE **** game down the line. Hopefully if this game flops, the developers will think twice before releasing another unfinished product.
